name: Victory On Paseo
about:
Victory on Paseo offers luxury student housing in San Diego, located near San Diego State University. The SDSU off-campus student community elevates the student living experience by providing spacious floor plans, modern features, resort-style amenities, and an unbeatable location in San Diego. You can choose from shared 3-bedroom apartments, 4-bedroom apartments and 5-bedroom apartments. Victory on Paseo's prime location offers easy access to downtown San Diego, local shopping, and the Historic West End District. With public transportation steps away from the building, you can expect to experience a convenient and comfort student life in there. FeaturesHere at Victory on Paseo, residents have exclusive access to a plethora of exciting, on-site amenities designed to cater to the student lifestyle. Our amenities equip SDSU students with everything they need to thrive in the academic and social lives!  Residents can meet new friends at our student recreation lounge, step outside to the pool deck for sunny afternoons or head up to the community roof deck for stunning views and fresh air—ideal for weekend gatherings or quiet moments, all the amenities make Victory on Paseo the perfect place for students to create your own community. For practical amenities in the building, our secure package lockers ensure your deliveries are always safe, while high-speed WiFi keeps you connected for study sessions or streaming your favorite shows. Safety is seamless with 24/7 controlled access and security cameras, giving you peace of mind day and night.  At the San Diego student housing, all the apartments are fully furnished, and the kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, and hardwood floors. The in-unit washer/dryer offers more convenience than the laundry room. Relax in flat-screen TVs and soundbars; central heating and air conditioning always keep your bedroom temperature comfortable. Penthouse floor plans at Victory on Paseo include a private roof deck accessed from within the apartment. 
Getting Around
Located just minutes from the San Diego State University’s campus, Victory On Paseo puts you at the center of San Diego with campus and local hotspots just minutes away!
Restaurants and shops:
Plant Power Fast Food: 7 minutes walk away

Del's Hideout: A popular Texas-style restaurants
Trader Joe's: a supermarket, 3 minutes drive away
SDSU Bookstore: a 9 minutes drive
Attractions:

Transport
The SDSU off-campus housing offers convenient access to public transportation, the nearest bus stop, Montezuma Rd & 55th St bus stop, is 3 minutes walk away from Victory On Paseo.
